evidence.title: Agility Robotics and Churchill Capital Corp XI S-4 Registration Statement Declared Effective by SEC in Connection with Proposed Business Combination
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore. & NEW YORK- -Agility Robotics, Inc. (“Agility” or the “Company”), a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced that its joint registration statement on Form S-4 (the “Registration Statement”) with Churchill Capital Corp XI (Nasdaq: CCXI) ("Churchill XI"), filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) in connection with the proposed business combination between Agility and Churchill XI, was declared effective by the SEC on October 13, 2026. This represents an important step in the process toward completion of the previously disclosed proposed business combination between Agility and Churchill XI. Churchill XI has set a meeting date of November 2, 2026 for its extraordinary general meeting to approve the proposed business combination and related matters. Agility develops humanoid robotics and physical AI systems that augment the human workforce by automating repetitive and physically demanding tasks.
